logp.method_description: To ensure complete saturation of the two phases, a mixture of 20 mL n-octanol and water (1:1 v/v) was vigorously shaken for 24 h at a constant temperature using an oscillator. Following Ir(III) complex was introduced into a mixture of 1 mL water-saturated n-octanol and 1 mL n-octanol-saturated water to attain a final concentration of 20 μM. The solution was mixed and vortexed overnight on a constant temperature oscillator to guarantee maximum partitioning of the complexes into the respective phases. To determine the concentration of the complexes in each phase, the absorbance of the aqueous phase was measured at 313, 360 and 370 nm (IrP, IrF and Ir-X, respectively) after reaching a stationary phase.
